safety.contact: Pay only inside opetlife. Never send a card-to-card transfer outside the site, and never share a verification code or password.
safety.payment: Pay only on this page. opetlife never asks you to transfer money to a personal account or to share a verification code.
safety.lostPet: Anyone who asks for money or a reward before returning a pet is probably a scammer. Meet in a public place and never pay in advance.
safety.donation: Donate only through this page. opetlife never asks you to transfer a donation to a personal account.
safety.adoption: Never pay a fee before meeting. See the pet in person and meet somewhere safe.

aboutPage.title: We built opetlife so caring for an animal never has to start from zero
aboutPage.lede: A vaccination booklet in a drawer, a vet’s number lost in a chat, a shop that doesn’t know about an allergy, a trip planned around “no pets allowed”. opetlife brings all of it together around one profile of your pet — and keeps it honest.

why.title: Care shouldn’t depend on remembering everything
why.p1: Living with a dog, a cat or a bird means hundreds of small decisions: when the next vaccine is due, which food suits a sensitive stomach, who can look after them when you travel. Most of that knowledge lives in scattered places — and when it is needed most, it is hard to find.
why.p2: opetlife started from a simple idea: the animal is at the centre, not the app. Everything we build — records, bookings, the shop, travel, rescue — reads from and adds to your pet’s own profile, so each step knows what came before.
why.p3: We write in Persian first, because that is where most of our families live, and in English, German and Spanish for everyone who lives with an animal far from home.

connect.title: One profile, many helping hands
connect.lede: Each part of opetlife does one job well and shares only what you allow.

record.title: Your pet’s record
record.body: Vaccinations, medications, allergies, weight and documents in one health file — with reminders before something is due.

care.title: Vets and services
care.body: Find clinics, groomers, sitters and pet taxis, see real available times and book; share the health record with a vet for a limited time.

shop.title: Shop
shop.body: Food, treats and accessories, chosen with your pet’s species and needs in mind.

travel.title: Travel
travel.body: Pet-friendly stays and trips; every external listing shows its source and when we last checked it.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: Lost-pet alerts, a pet ID card and plain comparisons of insurance plans, for the days you hope never come.

together.title: Community and rescue
together.body: Talk with other owners, support verified rescue groups and see exactly where donations go.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Practical articles and guides on training, nutrition and health, written to be used at home.

promises.title: What we promise — and how you can check it
promises.lede: Trust shouldn’t be a slogan. These are things the product does, and you can see them for yourself.

verified.title: Verified means checked
verified.body: Clinics, vets and service providers get a verified badge only after our team has reviewed their documents.

consent.title: Your pet’s record, your decision
consent.body: A health record is shared only when you choose to share it, for a limited time, and you can revoke access at any moment.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.body: From your privacy centre you can download a copy of your data or ask us to delete it.

sources.title: Honest about where things come from
sources.body: Listings from other websites show their source and when we last checked them; we never present them as our own.

ledger.title: Donations you can follow
ledger.body: Every rescue campaign shows a running total built from real transactions — never an estimate.

credits.title: Credit where it’s due
credits.body: Photos and music made by others are credited with their licence on our credits page.

values.title: How we decide what to build

animals.title: The animal comes first
animals.body: If a feature is good for business but not for the animal, we don’t build it.

honest.title: Say what we know — and what we don’t
honest.body: No made-up availability, no invented reviews, no medical promises. When something is uncertain, we say so.

simple.title: Simple for every family
simple.body: Clear words, large buttons, light and dark themes, and pages that work on any phone.

kindness.title: Kindness counts
kindness.body: Rescue, adoption and remembering the animals we have lost are part of opetlife, not an afterthought.

contact.title: Talk to us
contact.body: Questions, ideas, a partnership or something that didn’t work as it should: your message reaches our support team, and you’ll see the reply in your support inbox.

cta.title: Start with your pet’s profile
cta.body: It takes a minute, and everything else builds on it.

adminDraft.body: These texts were written from how the platform actually works and are shown in all six languages until you publish a reviewed version. Publishing Terms or Privacy here for Persian or English replaces the built-in text for that language. Points to check with a lawyer: the 48-hour return window next to the statutory right of withdrawal for distance purchases, where refunds go (original method or wallet), account deletion (execution is still switched off), and community posts appearing before review.
